name: White planet
description: The second planet from the Sun, Venus would be a rather unpleasant place to live. With surface temperatures hot enough to melt lead, Venus is pretty much the equivalent of hell.
interestingFacts: One of three paints created for the July event War of Space.
The paint could be received as a reward for reaching the paid Tier 48 of the August 2019 Challenge.
Prior to its release in challenges, the paint used to be named, Venus.
Venus was added to the possible rewards pool of containers with the release of the September 2019 Challenge.
